title: Preservation of Scripture
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The preservation of Scripture means that God faithfully keeps His Word so His people are not left without truth. The Word of the Lord endures, even though human life, cultures, rulers, and generations pass away.
summary: The preservation of Scripture means that God faithfully keeps His Word so His people are not left without truth. The Word of the Lord endures, even though human life, cultures, rulers, and generations pass away.
christFocus: Jesus declared that His words would not pass away. The preservation of Scripture assures believers that the Word bearing witness to Christ, His Gospel, and His promises remains trustworthy for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God’s Word endures because God Himself is faithful. Human beings are like grass, and human glory fades, but the Word of the Lord stands forever. God’s truth is not fragile in the hands of history.

Preservation does not mean every physical copy, translation, or human handling of Scripture has been perfect. It means God has faithfully kept His Word so that His people are not abandoned to darkness, uncertainty, or silence.

The preserved Word continues to speak across generations. Kingdoms rise and fall, cultures shift, languages change, and opposition comes against God’s truth, but Scripture remains the living testimony of God’s revelation.

This doctrine strengthens confidence in reading, preaching, translating, teaching, and obeying Scripture. God has not merely spoken in the past and then lost His Word. He continues to sustain His truth for His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Believers may wonder whether they can truly trust the Bible they hold. Skeptics may suggest that God’s Word has been lost, overcome, or made useless by time. Preservation answers with confidence in God’s faithfulness rather than fear.

This doctrine also comforts the church in seasons of opposition. No government, culture, persecution, corruption, or spiritual enemy can erase what God has determined to preserve. His Word stands because He stands.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive Scripture with gratitude as the enduring Word of God. Do not treat the Bible as a temporary religious artifact or outdated human record. Read it, teach it, proclaim it, and preserve faithfulness to it in your home, ministry, church, and daily walk.
